correctness.rationale: For smooth marked genus-3 Ciani quartics in characteristic 5, the prime-to-5 degree-8 isogeny to three elliptic quotients reduces p-rank to the number of ordinary factors. Hasse polynomials Fx,Fy,Fz have pairwise differences (a²+1)(b²-c²), etc., whose first factors are units on the smooth parameter locus. Each double vanishing splits into two rational parametrizations; after excluding singular values each is A1 minus five points. Distinct components intersect only at eight transverse triple zeros over F25; counts N0(5^m)=8[even m], N1(5^m)=6(5^m-3)-36[even m]. Independently checked all three polynomial difference identities modulo5, rational component parametrizations and excluded smoothness factors with exact polynomial reduction. A separate GF25 implementation enumerated all smooth triples: at q=5 rank1=12 and rank0=0; at q=25 rank1=96 and rank0=8. Finite counts corroborate the algebraic parametrization, not its all-extensions proof.
residual_risks: Finite independent checks do not prove unrestricted assertions; infinite cases depend on the indicated symbolic/structural proof.
